payload.explanation: The diagnostic report identifies the business request (session_183d2e59298d) as blocked on an advisory transaction lock held by session_0a730a8d1abd, which is idle in transaction. The state report confirms session_0a730a8d1abd is the only eligible rollback target (allowed_actions includes rollback_session, released=false), while the business request session must not be modified directly. Rolling back the blocker releases the lock so the inventory decrement can complete.
